title: chattocorp/chatto
claim: chattocorp/chatto — A fully-featured team and group chat application that you can easily selfhost.
why_good: A full-featured, easily self-hosted team chat — the open Slack/Mattermost lane for orgs that want to own their data.
value: Hosting + enterprise (SSO, compliance, support) to privacy/sovereignty-minded teams, the Mattermost/Rocket.Chat playbook.
risk: Slack/Teams own distribution and Mattermost/Rocket.Chat already occupy open self-host; hard to pull teams over.
pick_reason: The self-hosted chat application addresses privacy concerns and can be monetized through subscription or support services.

zh.claim: chattocorp/chatto —— 功能齐全、易自托管的团队与群组聊天应用。
zh.why_good: 一个功能齐全、易自托管的团队聊天——面向想掌控自己数据的组织的开源 Slack/Mattermost 赛道。
zh.value: 给注重隐私/数据主权的团队卖托管 + 企业版(SSO、合规、支持),Mattermost/Rocket.Chat 的打法。
zh.risk: Slack/Teams 掌握分发,Mattermost/Rocket.Chat 已占开源自托管;很难把团队撬过来。
